name: navflow
description: Connect Claude Code to NavFlow — query your data plane over MCP, and stream this session into NavFlow's claude_code source.

navflow_url.title: NavFlow URL
navflow_url.description: Base URL of your NavFlow daemon. Local default works for `navflow up`; set your remote URL otherwise.

ingest_token.title: Auth token (optional)
ingest_token.description: Only if your NavFlow requires auth (NAVFLOW_AUTH_TOKEN / INGEST_TOKEN). Sent as a Bearer header to the MCP proxy and the ingest endpoint.

stream_sessions.title: Stream this session into NavFlow
stream_sessions.description: When on, this session's transcript is shipped to NavFlow's claude_code source as it progresses.
